evidence:
Seed: task/environment/assets/seed_data.json is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. ..."}; it holds no record, title, source or marker, so no probe value can be found in it. Reference initial state: solve.sh removes /app/app.db, app.db-wal and app.db-shm before copying the app; server.js lines 147-168 only CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and back-fill revisions from existing snippets (INSERT OR IGNORE ... SELECT ... FROM snippets), inserting no snippet of its own; app.tsx starts with useState('') for the code, 'snippet.js', 'Untitled', snippets [], entries [], status 'Ready', conflict null, so on first load the editor is empty, the library reads 'No saved snippets yet', the console reads 'Console is clear', and no conflict, newer-revision or stop/time-limit status is displayed. Probe values: almost every distinctive value is chosen by the judge at grading time ('unique title', 'distinctive marker', 'You may choose the exact fixture text' in functional/prompt.md). The only literals fixed by the criteria are the typed burst 'MUL'+'TI' (cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic) and the words eval, Function, WebAssembly, Worker, import. A case-insensitive grep of solution/app/src, server.js, index.html, runner.html and environment/ for MULTI finds only the CSS class 'multi-caret' (custom-editor.js:1221, style.css:20) and 'aria-multiline'; neither is editor source text, which is what the criterion reads ('The suffix must appear exactly once at each caret'), and both are lower case. The dynamic-code criterion requires payload markers 'that the draft builds by joining two halves, so the whole marker never appears in the source text', which rules out the marker being present before execution. Outcome notices that criteria wait for are conditional in the golden: the conflict notice renders only when `conflict` is set and the newer-revision notice only when remote.revision > record.revision (app.tsx:153-154), and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft itself requires a baseline ('confirm that A shows no notice about a newer revision yet'). cw_unsaved_marker starts from a saved state where no indication may be shown; cw_undo_redo_availability starts by creating history first. Records are found by judge-chosen unique titles and app_context.md says 'Do not assume an empty library'. Raw evidence: the scripted golden results on these bytes (results/persist-before.json, all eight entries true, pageErrors []) create timestamp-stamped titles and find exactly one matching library entry (tests/persist.cjs:59,133,136), consistent with no pre-existing matching record; recomputed SHA256 of run_golden.sh, all seven tests/*.cjs and all results/*.json listed in the index match the index. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, so the judge's actual chosen probe values are not measured; this row does not depend on that measurement because the seed and initial state are empty of content. NOTES (not defects for this row): (1) The golden footer permanently shows '5s run budget' (app.tsx:171); cw_time_limit_recovery and cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget ask that 'a visible time-limit reason must appear', and the golden satisfies them through the changing run status, but a careless judge could mistake a static hint in some submission for that reason. It is not a judge-created value and the criteria say 'appear', so it is outside this row's defect definition. (2) New in the golden loads a two-line example ('

Hello, Colderwater

' / 'Ready to explore.') and the default title 'Untitled'; cw_save_reload_restart begins with New and then needs its own two-line source containing an ampersand, the word eval and a marker, plus 'an exact unique title', none of which the example supplies, so the prefilled draft cannot satisfy it; the judge must replace it, as app_context.md instructs ('check it equals your fixture before acting'). (3) check-probe-not-in-seed.py, which the skill says owns this check, was not available to run; this verdict is a manual application of its documented behaviour, not a checker run.
